scope: Independent local review of the frozen metadata-only RNG diagnostic source/admission packet. No SSH, remote query, unit action, tests, checkpoint/model payload, or array/data payload was read by this reviewer.

review.verdict: No material blocker found in the frozen diagnostic packet; root must satisfy its fresh admission gates before the one diagnostic submission.
findings: The rendered body’s AST matches its template after normalizing only the generated PAYLOAD assignment. All 17 embedded payload byte lengths and SHA-256 values match PREPARATION.json, and the pinned local metadata/source inputs still match those hashes.

The script verifies the SHA-256 and import path of the exact f270 checker, then calls that checker’s existing `_load_checkpoint(training_state.pt, 64 MB)` restricted weights-only loader. It checks the captured training-state stat before and after load; it opens no model checkpoint, optimizer payload separately, dataset, or prediction array.

The output contains format/next_epoch, installed Torch version, RNG keys/types/cardinalities, and tensor dtype/shape/numel/SHA-256 only. Tensor values and model/optimizer values are not emitted. No CUDA RNG shape or length is assumed by this review; it remains unknown until the diagnostic’s persisted output is inspected.

The new admission binds the prior failed support capture/admission/launch/log and its exact guard message, and proves the state stat matches the prior failed verifier’s captured output inventory. It uses a new output path and unit and does not query, stop, restart, or retry the failed V1 unit.

The body reuses the frozen source/split/data/cache/native checks and fresh parent gates: exact native invocation/typed exit, 167-file source tree, cache acceptance/exact stop, all populated descendants empty, 17-GB support headroom, physical scratch and 25-GiB project-disk floor. The diagnostic unit keeps 0.5 CPU, 1.4-GB high/1.5-GB max, zero swap, 600 seconds, hidden CUDA and one BLAS thread.

The body creates a separate unique output only after gates, submits once, and fsyncs an exclusive launch record. Submit timeout and post-submit query errors are retained as unknown outcomes with an explicit no-retry rule.
review.reported_local_checks: The frozen local-check receipt reports the f270 restricted loader/safe-global binding, payload/template AST checks, cold stdlib metadata-read sentinels, Ruff, and one-submit/create-only/unknown-outcome checks PASS. This reviewer did not rerun checks.
limits: This is source/admission review only; it does not establish the RNG tensor’s actual size, any corrected checker condition, terminal integrity, or quality.
The diagnostic is not a terminal checker or acceptance. Any checker correction must use the actual diagnostic output and receive separate source review before a new verifier attempt.
